response.text:
**"What you will need on day one."**: **Mandatory** (Python, SQL)
- **"need"** states a requirement, not a preference.
- **"on day one"** means you must have these skills when you start, not learn them on the job.

**"What would make you stand out."**: **Optional** (Grafana, technical writing)
- **"stand out"** means these set you apart from other candidates. They aren't the baseline.
- **"would"** is conditional. It describes an advantage, not a requirement.

The numbering runs straight through both sections (1–4), so the list numbers don't tell you which group an item belongs to. Only the header wording does.
